result.reason: The clause reaches the fallback position: Customer retains approximately one-month notice, which is more favorable than the fallback notice period; early-termination charges are capped at three months’ recurring charges; and post-termination prepaid charges are refunded. It does not add any Vendor convenience-termination right. The changes are targeted and preserve the original scope and prerequisite-attachment limitation. Drafting quality is reduced because the trailing “and IBM will refund” is awkwardly included within item (b), potentially making IBM’s refund appear to be part of the conditions by which Customer terminates, and the “which” modifier could be clearer.
